architecture: 6 cameras -> frozen OpenDriveFM backbone -> z(384) -> trainable projector -> 4 prefix embeddings -> frozen GPT-2 (85.4M, vocab 404) -> residual waypoint tokens
tokenisation: residual on constant-velocity prior, 200 bins over ±10.0 m per axis, mean quantisation error 0.534 m
caveats: 80 keyframes total, 64 train / 16 val. This demonstrates the mechanism end to end; it is far too little data for the number to be a model result.

The frozen GPT-2 is the repo's own checkpoint, previously fine-tuned on 404 copies of an all-zero trajectory. Its language-modelling ability was damaged by that run, so it is a weak prior here. The pretrained GPT-2 could not be substituted: huggingface.co is blocked by this environment's egress policy.
Decoding is constrained so even positions emit x-bins and odd positions y-bins; without that the model can emit syntactically invalid sequences.
Compared against the constant-velocity prior it predicts residuals on, which is the honest baseline for this design.
